title: Tahini Bao Bites
description: Crunchy and savory bites filled with a creamy tahini filling, wrapped in soft bao dough.

ingredients.name: Bao dough
ingredients.notes: available in most Asian grocery stores

instructions: Roll out the bao dough to 1/4 inch thickness.
Cut out small squares of dough, about 3 inches per side.
Place a small spoonful of tahini in the center of each square.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a triangle or a square, and press the edges together to seal.
Brush the tops with sesame oil and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until golden brown.
